formal_statement: ∀ (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin 13 → ℕ), (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ (w : Fin 13) (x : Fin 13 → Bool), ((Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin 13 => x p = false)).card = 5 ∨ (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin 13 => x p = false)).card = 6) → PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.eval ⟨gates, out w⟩ (List.ofFn x) = decide (∃ v ∈ (({0, 1, 3, 9} : Finset (Fin 13)).image (fun u => u + w)), x v = true)) → 39 ≤ gates.length
plain_statement: Take the 13 points 0..12 and the 13 lines {w, w + 1, w + 3, w + 9} (mod 13). Every list of AND and OR gates, each reading at most two wires, that has for each line a wire equal to the OR of the line's four points on every input with exactly 5 or exactly 6 false points, has at least 39 gates.
title: The 13 line-ORs of the plane of order 3, right on every input with exactly 5 or 6 false points, need at least 39 AND/OR gates of fan-in two
